name: Thug Racer
author: Addicting Games
description: This is the coastline flying by at 80 miles an hour. This is fly hunnies in the backseat and chumps in the trunk. This isn't just racing, this is Thug Racing! A fast, furious, and nostalgic racing game with a vaporwave feel and an eighties throwback look. In Thug Racer, you'll only have your mouse to dodge cops, other cars, palm trees, and the various other obstacles that the California coast throws at you. Watch out for palm trees and other drivers as you navigate down the highway and put up with the non-stop chatter and annoyance of your passenger and co-pilot who will give you tips, advice and endless lectures about your failures as a driver if you let him down. So, sit down, strap in put the pedal to the metal and blast off into the thug life with this fun paced 16-bit race game.
